2609.02250.title: RideSkill: A Hierarchical Algorithm for Generalized Ride Sharing with LLM-Driven Automatic Evolution
2609.02250.paper_summary: Ride-sharing, which allows multiple passengers with different origin-destination (OD) pairs to share a single vehicle, is a challenging operational problem, as it requires orders with different OD pairs to be efficiently bundled and assigned to vehicles under uncertain and varying scenarios. Although multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) solutions have achieved promising performance, they suffer from limited generalization (adapting to different environmental scenarios), low transferability (adapting to different platform objectives), and training difficulties in large-scale systems, such as the curse of dimensionality. Recently, motivated by the scaling of large language models (LLMs), several works have incorporated LLMs into ride-hailing systems, either by employing LLMs directly as decision-making agents or using them for automatic algorithm design. However, none of these approaches support vehicle sharing, which complicates the problem by expanding both the state and action spaces exponentially. Moreover, most of them require frequent LLM calls at inference time, making them infeasible for real-time deployment. To address these issues, we propose RideSkill, a hierarchical method for ride-sharing that leverages LLM-assisted automatic algorithmic design. RideSkill consists of a combiner that assigns appropriate skills to each vehicle from a learned skill repository, enabling adaptive dispatch under varying scenarios and objectives, and a repositioner that sequentially relocates idle vehicles to emerging regions, avoiding conflicts among vehicles. Crucially, the skill repository, combiner, and repositioner are all trained by an LLM-based automatic evolutionary method, eliminating the need for LLM calls during deployment and thus ensuring high real-time performance.
2609.02250.paper_summary_zh: 共乘系統允許多位乘客擁有不同的起點-終點（OD）對，共享一輛車輛，這是一個具有挑戰性的運營問題，因為它要求將擁有不同 OD 對的訂單有效地打包並分配給車輛，並在不確定和變化的情境下進行操作。儘管多智能體強化學習（MARL）解決方案已取得了令人鼓舞的表現，但它們在有限的泛化能力（適應不同的環境情境）、低轉移性（適應不同的平台目標）以及在大規模系統中的訓練困難（如維度詛咒）方面存在問題。最近，受到大型語言模型（LLMs）擴展的啟發，一些研究將 LLMs 融入到叫車系統中，無論是直接將 LLMs 作為決策代理，還是利用它們進行自動算法設計。然而，這些方法都不支持車輛共享，這使得問題變得更加複雜，因為它們指數級地擴大了狀態和行動空間。此外，它們中的大多數在推理時需要頻繁調用 LLM，這使得它們不適合實時部署。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了 RideSkill，一種利用 LLM 輔助自動算法設計的層級共乘方法。RideSkill 包含一個組合器，從學習到的技能庫中為每輛車輛分配適當的技能，使其能夠在不同的情境和目標下進行自適應調度，以及一個重新定位器，依次將閒置車輛重新安置到新興區域，避免車輛之間的衝突。關鍵是，技能庫、組合器和重新定位器都是通過基於 LLM 的自動進化方法進行訓練的，這消除了在部署期間對 LLM 調用的需求，從而確保了高實時性能。
